Name: }bedrock.session.start

Parameters.Name: pConnectionName
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Name of the connection region (sConnectionName) to use. If blank, sThisDatabaseName is used

Parameters.Name: pRunProcessMode
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Also write the return value to <pConnectionName>.json, for callers that start the session with RunProcess (e.g. when connection values are read from a cube). File may contain a token or session cookie (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pAddress
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Server address or hostname (e.g. us-east-1.planninganalytics.saas.ibm.com). Default = localhost

Parameters.Name: pPort
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: HTTP port of the TM1 server. Leave blank to use the scheme's default port

Parameters.Name: pSSL
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Use https instead of http (Boolean. Default = 1)

Parameters.Name: pBaseURL
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Explicit base URL that overrides pAddress/pPort/pSSL. Ignored for IBM_CLOUD_API_KEY and SERVICE_TO_SERVICE

Parameters.Name: pUser
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: TM1 user name. Required for BASIC, CAM and SERVICE_TO_SERVICE

Parameters.Name: pPassword
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: TM1 user password. Required for BASIC and CAM

Parameters.Name: pNamespace
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: CAM namespace. Required for CAM

Parameters.Name: pAuthMode
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: BASIC, CAM, IBM_CLOUD_API_KEY, ACCESS_TOKEN or SERVICE_TO_SERVICE. If blank, auto-detected from the supplied parameters

Parameters.Name: pAPIKey
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: IBM Cloud API key. Required for IBM_CLOUD_API_KEY

Parameters.Name: pIAMURL
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: IBM Cloud IAM token URL. Default = https://iam.cloud.ibm.com/identity/token

Parameters.Name: pTenant
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Planning Analytics SaaS tenant ID. Required for IBM_CLOUD_API_KEY

Parameters.Name: pDatabase
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: TM1 database name. Required for IBM_CLOUD_API_KEY and SERVICE_TO_SERVICE

Parameters.Name: pInstance
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: PA Engine instance name. Required for SERVICE_TO_SERVICE

Parameters.Name: pAccessToken
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Pre-issued bearer token. Required for ACCESS_TOKEN

Parameters.Name: pApplicationClientId
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Application client ID. Required for SERVICE_TO_SERVICE

Parameters.Name: pApplicationClientSecret
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Application client secret. Required for SERVICE_TO_SERVICE

Parameters.Name: pSessionContext
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Value sent in the TM1-SessionContext header (Default = Bedrock)

Parameters.Name: pLogOutput
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Write parameters and action summary to server message log. Secrets are never logged (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pStrictErrorHandling
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: On encountering any error, exit with major error status by ProcessQuit after writing to the server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pJson
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: JSON Object with process parameter values. This will overwrite user passed parameters for all included parameters.
